records.finding: The author claim that the frozen MCP article does not establish a default-following consumer endpoint or promotion behavior is false. Its Toolbox versioning tip expressly says the consumer endpoint always serves the promoted default version and recommends testing a version-specific endpoint before promotion. No documentation-to-documentation hop is needed for that passage. However, the exact default_version property spelling and a general immutability contract are not established there, and the original citations are absent from the approved current corpus. This is disposition correction, not a new generation or technical approval of the old hash.

choices.rationale: Central toolbox versioning changes the shared configuration; changing an agent prompt while leaving that configuration unchanged is not the documented release operation.
The MCP article describes reusing centralized tools and credentials; independent copies discard the requested shared release mechanism.

The tip distinguishes version-specific testing from a consumer endpoint following the promoted default. Promotion cannot be assumed to replace a caller explicit old-version selection; the adjective immutable still needs its own approved evidence.
The actual tip recommends iterating/testing a new version and having production consumers use the endpoint serving the promoted default.

records.requiredNextStep: A grounded author may reconsider the retained fact under its existing ID with corrected current citations, removing or separately grounding exact field/immutability assertions. That new content needs a genuine generation timestamp and fresh technical plus adversarial contexts. Do not reuse this disposition record as a pass.
